title: [spec-gap][R-12-057] SOS dispatch byte 0x16: no emitter anywhere; Rust rejects it
description: spec/12-apps.md:852-858 (18.4.3, REQUIRED): sender MUST emit SOS with link-layer dispatch byte 0x16 carrying the 18.4.2 CBOR alert map, NOT as SCHC-compressed CoAP; relays classify solely by this byte. Evidence: no sender in C/Python/Rust emits 0x16; C classifies but no consumer (l2_payload.h:34, lichen_link_rx.c:327); Python classifies only (constants.py:44, l2_payload.py:40, node.py:923); Rust lichen-core/src/l2_payload.rs:83 test asserts classify_known(&[0x16]) == Err(UnknownDispatch) — direct conflict with spec 02-physical-link.md:237-244, C, and Python. Consequence: 18.4.3 rebroadcast-once and the 3/hour SOS budget cannot work. Placement: rust/lichen-core l2_payload SOS variant + TX emission paths in all stacks.
